proposal.boundary: Corrected receiver-only proposal: no Edge upstream, Hub fixture, Home Assistant or producer event. A fresh owner-only startup bearer is required through the dedicated environment path even though no record is submitted.

authorization: Hub authorizes one bounded readiness-only receiver run on the existing macos13-arm64 guest. Start only the exact receiver, verify loopback 21444 and 21445/status, then stop it and the guest. This does not authorize an event or forwarding.

candidate.identity: arm64 Mach-O, macOS 13.0 minimum, system-only dependencies; target loader receipt passed

fresh_roots.modes: Host/guest roots and directories 0700; receiver 0500; config/key 0600; public certificate and client CA 0644

config.binding: 127.0.0.1:21444 receiver; 127.0.0.1:21445 status; exact pinned receiver template fields only

fresh_tls.verification: Server leaf is CA:FALSE with IP SAN 127.0.0.1, serverAuth, critical digitalSignature/keyEncipherment, valid chain and matching key. Client-auth trust is a fresh CA:TRUE certificate. Private CA keys stay host-side and are not copied or disclosed.

fresh_startup_bearer.mode_and_shape: 0600 single-link owner-only regular file; 65 bytes containing 64 printable lowercase hex characters plus newline
fresh_startup_bearer.boundary: Fresh receiver startup dependency only. No Edge upstream exists and no record/event is authorized, so it will not be used for a request.

required_checks: Guest is macOS 13.7.4 build 22H420 arm64 admin UID 501
Fresh guest root is absent and ports 21444/21445 are free before create
Exact candidate/config/TLS hashes and modes match after staging
Only the candidate process owns loopback listeners 21444 and 21445
GET http://127.0.0.1:21445/status returns HTTP 200 with status ok
runtime.forbidden: No Edge process, 8080 listener, client leaf, producer, payload, Hub/HA action, retained-state reuse, install, LaunchAgent, Viewer or x86 work. A fresh receiver startup bearer may be added only after Edge corrects the proposal; it does not authorize an Edge process or event.

first_start_diagnostic.result: Receiver exited code 2 before readiness and before any event.
first_start_diagnostic.error: teslatlas bearer file path is missing or invalid
first_start_diagnostic.root_cause: The pinned Teslatlas producer constructor unconditionally loads TESLATLAS_FLEET_TELEMETRY_BEARER_FILE during receiver startup. Receiver-only operation does not require an Edge upstream process, but it still requires a fresh owner-only printable bearer file and absolute environment path.
first_start_diagnostic.closure: No receiver process remained and ports 21444/21445 were closed. The guest and fresh unconsumed root remain under Hub custody pending Edge's minimal proposal correction.
first_start_diagnostic.data_boundary: No producer, envelope, payload, Edge request, Hub/HA action, listener readiness or credential reuse occurred.

cleanup.action: Completed: the attached SSH interruption left exact receiver PID 567 reparented to PID 1, so Hub identified that exact command/PID and sent only PID 567 SIGTERM. The process exited; 21444/21445 closed; versioned guest/host roots were retained as non-reusable evidence; only macos13-arm64 was stopped.
cleanup.failure_rule: Any identity, mode, bind, process-parentage or status mismatch stops the run before any data-bearing action.

result.listener_owner: Exact c2ace receiver PID 567 owned both listeners; no wildcard or non-loopback bind.
result.status_probe: GET http://127.0.0.1:21445/status returned HTTP 200 with two-byte body ok.
result.receiver_shutdown: The receiver was explicitly terminated with SIGTERM after its attached SSH session interruption did not stop it; exact exit code was not captured. PID 567 and ports 21444/21445 were then absent.
result.guest_after: macos13-arm64 stopped; Debian ARM64 and paused x86 guest untouched; shared heavy-build lock absent.
result.evidence_boundary: Receiver startup, loopback listener, status response and bounded shutdown only.

proof_boundary: A pass proves the exact target-compatible receiver can start with fresh TLS, bind only loopback, report status, and stop cleanly on macOS 13. It does not prove Edge service readiness, event admission, forwarding, Hub/HA integration, service lifecycle or platform acceptance.
